ACME ROBOTICS, INC.
Series A Investor Deck - June 2026
Warehouse automation robots with AI-native fleet orchestration.
HQ: Taipei / San Jose. Founded 2022. Team of 34.
CONFIDENTIAL

PROBLEM & SOLUTION
Mid-size 3PL warehouses cannot afford fixed conveyor automation.
Acme deploys autonomous mobile robots (AMR) with per-pick pricing.
Deployment in 3 weeks vs 9 months for fixed automation.
Robots-as-a-Service (RaaS): monthly subscription + usage fee.

TRACTION
FY2025 revenue: US$3.2M (2.4x YoY)
Deployed fleets: 41 sites, 388 robots (June 2026)
Net revenue retention: 128%
Top-10 customers = 68% of revenue
US market entered 2025Q4; US = 40% of new bookings in 2026H1

UNIT ECONOMICS
Gross margin: 58% (FY2025)
CAC payback: 11 months
Average contract: 24 months, US$8,400 MRR per site
Robot BOM cost down 31% since 2024 via in-house controller

COMPETITION
Locus Robotics, 6 River (Ocado), Geek+ - enterprise-first, heavy CAPEX
Acme wedge: mid-market 3PL, 3-week deployment, per-pick pricing
No direct competitor in TW/JP mid-market segment today

THE ROUND
Raising: US$8.0M Series A
Pre-money: US$40.0M
Use of funds: US fleet ops 45% / R&D 30% / WC 25%
Existing investors: Vertex Growth 12.0% (1,200,000 shares),
Harbor Angels 6.5%
Founders retain 58% fully diluted
